ng-add.description: Add @open-rlb/ng-app to a workspace: install the dependencies, create the core application (angular.json, app shell, environment) and point the package.json scripts at it.

sync-skills.description: Copy the Claude skills bundled with the installed version of @open-rlb/ng-app into .claude/skills. Re-runnable: this is how consumers pick up skill updates after npm update.
